# Kode — llms.txt
# https://llmstxt.org

## What is Kode?

Kode (https://kode.ug) is a QR-powered commerce platform built for restaurants, bars, event venues, and other hospitality businesses in Uganda.

## What it does

- **QR menus and ordering**: Merchants generate a QR code that customers scan with any phone camera. No app download required. Customers browse the menu, add items to a cart, and submit an order that arrives in real time on the merchant's kitchen/counter screen.
- **Kitchen display system (KDS)**: Orders appear live on a dedicated kitchen screen. Staff mark items as preparing, ready, and completed. The customer's phone shows live order status.
- **Event ticketing**: Merchants create events, set ticket tiers (General, VIP, etc.), and share a QR. Customers scan to purchase tickets via mobile money. At the gate, staff scan printed or digital tickets to validate entry.
- **Quick payments**: Anyone — no account required — can create a fixed-price payment QR code for one-off collections (parking fees, tips, donations, entry fees). Customers scan and pay via mobile money. The QR creator tracks payments using an emailed tracking number.
- **Payment tracking**: Supports MTN Mobile Money and Airtel Money. All transactions are tracked with statuses (Pending, Processing, Completed, Failed).
- **Merchant dashboard**: Authenticated merchants manage their catalog (items, categories, photos), view orders, manage tables, configure floor plans, and see revenue analytics.
- **Admin console**: Separate web console for platform operators to manage businesses, users, roles, and platform-level analytics.

## Who it is for

- Restaurants, cafés, bars, and hotels in Uganda wanting digital menus and orders without a tablet app per table.
- Event promoters wanting to sell and validate tickets without a separate ticketing service.
- Anyone needing a quick payment collection QR (parking lot operators, market stalls, event organisers).

## Technology

- Frontend: React 19 SPA (Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS)
- Backend: Java 21 / Spring Boot 3.4 REST + WebSocket API
- Auth: Keycloak 26 (OpenID Connect / JWT)
- Database: PostgreSQL 16
- Realtime: Redis pub/sub for horizontally scaled WebSocket delivery
- Payments: MTN MoMo and Airtel Money APIs

## Company

Operated by QBI Labs SMC, Kampala, Uganda.
